ogDescription:
YPA Point Cook proudly presents 1 Leven Way, Point Cook—an exceptional family residence showcasing luxurious finishes, multiple living zones, outstanding entertaining spaces and a fully self-contained studio.

Immaculately presented and thoughtfully designed, this impressive single-level home is positioned in one of Point Cook's most desirable and convenient locations. Offering the perfect balance of elegance, comfort and versatility, it is ideal for growing families, multigenerational households and investors seeking additional accommodation potential.

From the moment you step inside, the soaring high ceilings, sophisticated colour palette and quality finishes create an immediate sense of luxury. The thoughtfully planned floorplan provides excellent space and separation, allowing every member of the family to enjoy comfort and privacy.

A beautifully presented formal lounge offers an elegant setting for welcoming guests or enjoying quiet evenings, while the expansive main living and dining area creates the perfect heart of the home. Filled with natural light, this inviting space has been designed for relaxed family living, entertaining and creating lasting memories together.

At the centre of the residence is the stunning designer kitchen, finished with bright modern cabinetry, premium appliances, a wall oven and an impressive 40mm waterfall stone benchtop. The generous walk-in pantry provides excellent storage and preparation space, while the oversized island bench is ideal for casual meals, morning coffee and entertaining family and friends.

Overlooking the open-plan living and dining zones, the kitchen connects effortlessly with the outdoor entertaining areas, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle.

The accommodation is equally impressive. The luxurious main bedroom provides a peaceful private retreat, complete with a spacious walk-in robe and beautifully appointed ensuite featuring dual vanities. The additional family bedrooms are generously sized and include mirrored built-in robes, while the stylish central bathroom features a relaxing bathtub and quality fittings.

A separate area offers the ideal environment for working from home, managing a business or supporting children with their studies. The home's flexible layout also provides multiple living areas, including a dedicated guest lounge and a spacious central family zone.

Adding remarkable versatility and value is the fully self-contained studio incorporated into the garage. Complete with its own private bedroom, comfortable living area, kitchenette and full bathroom, this impressive space is ideal for extended family members, independent teenagers, visiting guests or potential additional rental income.

Designed for year-round comfort, the home is equipped with refrigerated heating and cooling throughout. Remote-controlled blinds in every room provide added privacy, convenience and safety while enhancing the home's modern and luxurious appeal.

The outdoor entertaining area is truly made for memorable occasions. The covered alfresco extends to an additional decked pergola fitted with protective blinds, creating a comfortable and private entertaining space that can be enjoyed throughout summer and winter.

Whether you are hosting weekend barbecues, birthday celebrations, Christmas parties or relaxed family gatherings, this impressive outdoor setting provides the perfect backdrop. The secure backyard also offers space for children and pets to enjoy.

Perfectly positioned in a peaceful blue-chip pocket of Point Cook, the home is conveniently located near Williams Landing Station, Stockland Point Cook Shopping Centre, Waterhaven Park, local schools, childcare facilities, public transport and major road connections.

Exceptional Features Include:

Fully self-contained studio with a bedroom, living area, kitchenette and bathroom
Luxurious kitchen with premium appliances and a 40mm waterfall stone benchtop
Generous walk-in pantry and excellent storage
Multiple spacious living areas
Refrigerated heating and cooling throughout
Covered alfresco and decked pergola with protective blinds

Combining luxurious family living, sophisticated finishes, exceptional entertaining and the rare advantage of a self-contained studio, 1 Leven Way represents an outstanding lifestyle and investment opportunity in the heart of Point Cook.

This is more than a home—it is a complete family lifestyle designed for comfort, flexibility and unforgettable entertaining.

For further information or to arrange a private inspection, contact Sachin Goyat or Pardeep Chahal on 0470 345 549 today.
